messages.text:
Masa: Agghhh!
We showed them an embarrassing scene.{be01}
Yas: Hurrah! Hurrah!
My Pokémon! What...?

I thought they were looking at us, but
they were looking at their opponents...

Is that athlete looking at me?
No, he's not.

If I win in a Pokémon battle,
cheer for this team.{be01}

Ummmm. The cheering for this team
is not nearly loud enough...
